build_load_predictors: build a function call to load all surya predictors including layout, detection, recognition, ocr_error, and table_rec
create_layout_predictor: create a layout predictor using the surya foundation model checkpoint for document layout analysis
create_detection_predictor: create a text detection predictor with optional device and dtype configuration for OCR text regions
create_recognition_predictor: create an OCR recognition predictor using the surya foundation model for text content extraction
create_table_recognizer: create a table recognition predictor with optional device and dtype for table structure extraction
